tasks.label: Comparar index.html
tasks.command: powershell -Command "$r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/edinaldo1608/sua-lingerie-loja/main/index.html' -UseBasicParsing; Write-Output ('GitHub bytes: ' + $r.RawContentLength); Write-Output ('Local bytes: ' + (Get-Item 'C:\Users\Edinaldo\Downloads\Sua Lingerie\index.html').Length)"
